hands_on_engineering.instructions: Evaluate demonstrated hands-on software engineering. Use evidence of personally designing, building, testing, debugging, or shipping production software. Do not infer engineering ability from titles or skills lists.
criteria: No demonstrated coding experience
Technical collaboration but little evidence of personally building software
Has personally shipped scoped production features
Can independently design and build production features end to end
Can own systems, architecture, integrations, data models, and production tradeoffs
Deep engineering specialist with substantial systems-level or organization-wide technical ownership

product_ownership.instructions: Evaluate demonstrated ownership from problem definition through delivery and outcomes. Prioritize concrete evidence over job titles.
criteria: No product ownership
Executes predefined requirements
Owns scoped features
Owns meaningful product areas from discovery through delivery
Owns strategy, technical tradeoffs, metrics, and multiple product areas or teams
Organization-level product leadership with repeated major business outcomes

payments_depth.instructions: Evaluate demonstrated payments domain depth using actual systems and workflows owned.
criteria: No payments experience
Basic payment integration experience
Experience with payment providers or transaction workflows
Owns multiple payment workflows such as reconciliation, payouts, fees, or settlement
Deep ownership of international payment infrastructure, reconciliation, settlement, FX, wallets, and operational workflows
Payments infrastructure specialist operating at major financial-platform scale

ai_product_engineering.instructions: Evaluate practical experience using AI or LLM systems to build production software. Distinguish ordinary AI tool usage from designing agentic workflows, evaluations, guardrails, or AI-powered products.
criteria: No demonstrated AI experience
Uses AI productivity tools
Has built software using LLM APIs or coding agents
Has shipped production workflows using LLMs or agents
Designs agentic workflows, evaluations, testing, guardrails, and production integration
Deep AI/ML engineering including model training, serving, or advanced agent infrastructure

product_engineer_fit.instructions: Evaluate evidence that the candidate can independently move between product discovery, technical design, implementation, shipping, and iteration. Do not reward titles. Require evidence from experience bullets.
criteria: No fit
Primarily product or engineering with little crossover
Some meaningful crossover between product and engineering
Strong hybrid profile with end-to-end ownership
Repeated evidence of independently moving from ambiguous product problems to shipped technical solutions
Exceptional repeated product-engineering ownership at significant scale

primary_profile.instructions: Select the profile best supported by demonstrated work, weighting recent experience most heavily.

criteria.product_manager: Primarily defines product direction and coordinates delivery.
criteria.technical_product_manager: Product ownership with substantial technical architecture, API, data, or platform depth.
criteria.product_engineer: Personally moves between product definition and hands-on implementation.
criteria.software_engineer: Primarily owns implementation and technical systems.
criteria.forward_deployed_engineer: Combines engineering with direct customer or stakeholder problem solving and deployment.
criteria.other: None of the profiles clearly dominate.
